title: MCU.js 0.2 portable API and capability manifest
description: Validates a board-qualified MCU.js 0.2 capability manifest. The x-mcujs-contract annotation is the machine-readable public JavaScript contract used by runtime, documentation, and conformance tooling.

exposedPins.description: Authoritative set of safe MCU GPIO identifiers exposed by this firmware's public metadata and peripheral APIs. It includes intentional onboard GPIO endpoints and excludes reserved/internal implementation pins. Every MCU pin published through board.pins, board.devices, or a capability descriptor must appear here.

pinMap.description: Semantic aliases for safe, runtime-exposed board pins. This is not required to enumerate every entry in board.exposedPins.

onboardDevices.description: Physical onboard inventory. Omitted keys mean the device is not present.

onboardLed.description: Physical onboard LED. GPIO LEDs expose their MCU pin; managed LEDs are controlled only through board.led() and have no MCU GPIO pin.

capabilityMap.description: Immutable facts compiled into this firmware for this board. Unsupported capabilities are omitted.

bootCapability.description: Static boot and recovery controls compiled into this firmware. Dynamic safe-mode state is queried through board.safeMode().

constraints.board.pinAliasesExposed: Every board.pins alias resolves to a pin in board.exposedPins.
constraints.onboard.ledPinExposed: A GPIO-controlled onboard LED pin appears in board.exposedPins; managed LEDs have no MCU pin.
constraints.gpio.pinsExposed: Every GPIO-capable pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.gpio.outputPinsSubset: Every gpio.outputPins entry also appears in gpio.pins.
constraints.gpio.outputMode: The output mode and a non-empty gpio.outputPins list are present together.
constraints.pwm.pinsExposed: Every PWM-capable pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.pwm.frequencyRange: pwm.frequency.minHz is less than or equal to maxHz.
constraints.pwm.maxOutputs: pwm.maxOutputs does not exceed the number of PWM-capable pins.
constraints.adc.pinsExposed: Every ADC-capable pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.adc.channelPins: Every ADC channel pin appears in adc.pins.
constraints.adc.channelAliases: Every ADC channel alias resolves to that channel's pin in board.pins.
constraints.adc.voltageRange: When ADC voltage is supported, minVolts is strictly less than maxVolts.
constraints.adc.voltageRoutes: Supported ADC voltage conversion has at least one exposed pin and channel.
constraints.i2c.defaultBus: The I2C default bus appears in buses.
constraints.i2c.defaultRoute: The I2C default route appears in routes and uses defaultBus.
constraints.i2c.routeBus: Every I2C route bus appears in buses.
constraints.i2c.busRoutes: Every advertised I2C bus has at least one route.
constraints.i2c.routePinsExposed: Every I2C route pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.i2c.distinctRoutePins: SDA and SCL are distinct within each I2C route.
constraints.i2c.frequencyRange: i2c.frequency.minHz is less than or equal to maxHz.
constraints.spi.defaultBus: The SPI default bus appears in buses.
constraints.spi.defaultRoute: The SPI default route appears in routes and uses defaultBus.
constraints.spi.routeBus: Every SPI route bus appears in buses.
constraints.spi.busRoutes: Every advertised SPI bus has at least one route.
constraints.spi.routePinsExposed: Every SPI route pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.spi.distinctRoutePins: SCK and data roles required by the duplex mode are distinct within each SPI route.
constraints.spi.frequencyRange: spi.frequency.minHz is less than or equal to maxHz.
constraints.spi.defaultMode: The default SPI mode defined by the operation contract appears in capabilities.spi.modes.
constraints.spi.fixedBitsPerWord: The byte-oriented 0.2 SPI contract advertises exactly the executable 8-bit word format.
constraints.spi.fixedBitOrder: The byte-oriented 0.2 SPI contract advertises exactly the executable MSB-first bit order.
constraints.spi.writeBufferDMARequiresDma: The writeBufferDMA compatibility extension is advertised only when SPI DMA is available.
constraints.neopixel.pinsExposed: Every NeoPixel driver pin appears in board.exposedPins.
constraints.neopixel.defaultOrder: The default NeoPixel order defined by the operation contract appears in capabilities.neopixel.orders.
constraints.onboard.neopixelCapability: An onboard NeoPixel requires the external NeoPixel driver capability.
constraints.onboard.neopixelPin: The onboard NeoPixel pin appears in capabilities.neopixel.pins.
constraints.onboard.neopixelLength: The onboard NeoPixel length does not exceed capabilities.neopixel.maxLength.
constraints.onboard.neopixelOrder: The onboard NeoPixel order appears in capabilities.neopixel.orders.

fields.defaultFromCapability: omitted value comes from the referenced capability number
fields.allowedFromCapability: value must be a member of the referenced collection
fields.conditionalAllowedFromCapability: the referenced argument selects a narrower capability collection for this value
fields.minimumFromCapability: value must be greater than or equal to the referenced number
fields.maximumFromCapability: value or value length must be less than or equal to the referenced number
fields.maximumFromArgumentResource: value must be less than or equal to a runtime resource property resolved from the named argument
fields.minimumLength: value length must be greater than or equal to the fixed number
fields.routeFromCapability: the correlated argument tuple must equal one object in the referenced route collection
fields.defaultRouteFromCapability: omitted correlated route fields come from the referenced route object
fields.maximumFromCapabilityBitWidth: numeric result must be at most two raised to the referenced bit width minus one
fields.maximumFromOnboardDevice: value length must not exceed the referenced onboard-device number
fields.exclusiveMaximumFromConfiguration: value must be less than the referenced initialized configuration value
fields.invalidResourceError: programming error thrown when a runtime resource handle is unknown or stale

graphicsBufferHandle.meaning: Opaque handle returned by the RP graphics/screen subsystem.

i2cOptions.routeRule: sda and scl are either both omitted with bus omitted/equal to defaultBus, in which case defaultRoute supplies them, or both form a listed route

spiOptions.routeRule: sck, mosi, and miso are either all omitted with bus omitted/equal to defaultBus, in which case defaultRoute supplies them, or all form a listed route

ENXIO.name: Error
ENXIO.meaning: distinguishable external device absence or NACK

EIO.name: Error
EIO.meaning: hardware or native driver I/O failure

compatibility.policy: Aliases listed here remain available through the 0.x series when their target capability exists. They are not portable names and may be removed in 1.0 with migration notes.

aliases.name: board.ledPin
aliases.meaning: Legacy onboard LED identifier; it is not necessarily an MCU GPIO pin.
